cases.purpose: Vehicle footprint remains inside one continuously marked one-way traffic lane during straight travel; measures ordinary application without assigning a legal verdict.

candidate_risk.reason: Waypoint-centered route may put a vehicle corner across a narrow marked boundary or the local slice may clip a long body; inspect measured minimum clearance and source-camera marking visibility.

cases.purpose: Vehicle footprint crosses a recorded lane boundary during straight travel, with no passing participant or turn preparation; measure the raw spatial and time history, with no invented tolerance.

candidate_risk.reason: Lateral controller may not cross the marked boundary before capture ends, or the boundary may be absent or occluded in source cameras; inspect measured corner clearance history and decoded views.

cases.purpose: An otherwise comparable boundary crossing occurs while overtaking a separately recorded vehicle; independent review must establish whether the passing is lawful under applicable rules.

candidate_risk.reason: Overtaken vehicle may not remain on route or ego may fail to reverse measured longitudinal order while crossing; inspect original participant motion, order-reversal trace and decoded views.

straight travel route, camera profile and duration

observations.name: native_lane_boundaries
observations.method: Sample native lane boundary geometry and marking type/direction for every ego frame.

observations.name: ego_vehicle_footprint
observations.method: Sample all vehicle body corners in world coordinates and join to the marked lane boundary by frame.

observations.name: lane_boundary_overlap
observations.method: Compute signed distances of the ego footprint to each marked boundary; preserve raw time history and geometric uncertainty.

observations.name: passing_context
observations.method: Retain other vehicle pose, identity, overtaking order, and source-backed external passing facts.

runtime_uncertainties: The fixed C147331 travel cell may not support an actual lawful-turn exception; inspect candidate-cells.json and propose a compatible same-role binding to the lead.

law_text: Where such traffic lanes have been marked, it shall be unlawful for the operator of any vehicle to fail or refuse to keep such vehicle within the boundaries of any such lane except when lawfully passing another vehicle or preparatory to making a lawful turning movement.

evidence_review.method: Read the frozen evidence inventory; it lists zero accepted recordings, so no source-backed equivalence or reuse can be claimed. Compare only newly planned exact cases after capture.

alternatives_and_boundaries: Marked traffic lanes activate containment; compare inside-lane travel with an unexcused measured crossing.
The lawful-passing exception needs a recorded overtaken vehicle and external-rule context, compared with the same crossing without passing.
The lawful-turn-preparation exception needs a compatible turn cell or other proof of an actual lawful turn; the fixed travel cell may not support it.

turn_cell_review.reason: Fixed C147331 travel maneuver cannot realize preparatory action for an actual left turn; C5191 explicitly supports lane markings and left turn. This is a proposed additional binding, not an allocated assignment or completed turn case.

st.lane.evidence: Original Native waypoint road/lane identity, heading, width and local polygon are recorded per ego tick. Local slice remains a geometry proxy.

st.lane_marking.evidence: Native left and right marking types are read per tick; unmarked and missing boundaries are rejected. RGB review remains required.

rel.occupies.evidence: Saved measurement joins ego body corners to original waypoint lane polygon by Native frame and computes containment.

drv.straddles_marking.evidence: Signed corner clearances and segment boundary intersections use retained original body and lane geometry; no legal tolerance.

drv.overtaking.evidence: Original overtaken participant identity, body corners and velocity are retained per tick. Saved measurement projects both body centers along the Native lane heading and reports observed order reversal. Lawful passing still needs external facts and review.

drv.turning.evidence: Fixed travel cell cannot establish actual lawful turn. Proposed C5191 turn-cell allocation and turn source remain pending.

sig.turn_indicator.evidence: Native ego light-state readback is retained when the actor API exposes it; null remains unknown. Signaling alone cannot establish a lawful turn.

drv.lane_change.evidence: Lane identity and body footprint history could establish transition after complete exact runner and finalizer work.
